fields.description: Weekly issue featuring Christmas-themed editorials and satire, including appeals for charitable giving and commentary on holiday shopping and Miami’s winter tourist season. Articles discuss investment and development news (including Tex Rickard’s involvement in a Miami Beach dog track and Carl G. Fisher’s golf courses), local amusements and nightlife, and a society column. Includes letters to the editor on the cost and quality of milk for children and a request to locate a woman who left an unaddressed Christmas package. Contains extensive local advertising and event notices for Miami and Miami Beach.
